summary: F6 is fixed. The health wait now breaks out once the new server reports the target version, and the success report is sent best effort, so a control-plane outage no longer rolls back a healthy workspace. The new recovery path for an interrupted `upgrading` state also works: it finishes the update or restores the previous image and releases the reservation. Temp tests cover all of this, both test runs pass, every changed line is covered or exempt with a reason I accept, and no P0 or P1 findings remain.
